title: Column Chromatography & Mobile/Stationary Phase Selection

pedagogy.core_lab_linkage: Column packing and sample loading techniques

cognitive_progression.level_1_remember: Define fundamental laws, terminology, and bounds of Column Chromatography & Mobile/Stationary Phase Selection.
cognitive_progression.level_2_understand: Explain underlying physical mechanisms, instrumentation, and energy transitions.
cognitive_progression.level_3_apply: Solve quantitative analytical calculations using $$V_R = V_M + K_D V_S \quad | \quad \alpha = \frac{k_2'}{k_1'} = \frac{t_{R2} - t_M}{t_{R1} - t_M}$$.
cognitive_progression.level_4_analyze: Interpret spectral shifts, evaluate deviations, and troubleshoot analytical anomalies.

pedagogical_boundary.retained_scope: Classical gravity and low-pressure column chromatography, column dimensions and aspect ratios, stationary phases (silica gel, neutral/acidic alumina, Florisil), packing techniques (slurry wet packing vs dry tap packing), sample loading precautions to avoid channel channeling, isocratic vs step-gradient elution, mobile phase polarity series, collection of fractions, transition from gravity column to modern pressurized HPLC.
pedagogical_boundary.non_forced_clinical_rationale: Classical column operations, wet/dry packing fluid dynamics, mobile phase eluotropic series, and transition to high efficiency separation systems.

vision_filtering.policy: Separate core educational diagrams from decorative slide artifacts
